---
name: Feature / design proposal
about: Propose a change to the lock, interest, or intent-transfer model
labels: proposal
---

**What problem are you solving?**
Describe the real situation that doesn't work today — not the feature
itself yet.

**What are you proposing?**
Sketch the interface (CLI flags, schema, whatever's relevant) if you have
one in mind.

**Does this fit the project's scope?**
Check the README's "what this deliberately is not" list first. If your
proposal is a UI, an audit/compliance feature, or a background orchestrator,
say why it should be an exception rather than assuming it will be.
